Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last station to be built in 2023.[4]
  • The name of this station Leben is taken from the German language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which could be directly translated to "Cozy Residence".[5]
  • This station is surrounded by a Diamond Interchange which also serves as the Public Transport Interchange (PTI) of this island. Moreover, additional signages are provided to clear out direction confusion as vehicles passing through this interchange adopts Right-Hand Traffic.
  • In terms of Roads on Leben Island, the concourse of this station is situated at Shingking Road, and the platforms and tracks of this station cut Hipgeoi Avenue in half.
  • Despite being a Ground Station, the platforms are slightly submerged compared to the ground level of this island.
  • The lavatories and Station Control Room of this station are located at the platform level. This arrangement is similar to that of Chosen Surge Station and Airship Island Station respectively.

History[]

  • December 4 2023: The Island on which this station is located (Leben) completed reclamation works.
  • December 9 2023: This Station began construction.
  • December 14 2023: This Station completed construction.
  • December 18 2023: This Station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate Samuel, the owner of Inter-Galactic Media Group, photobombing into the Second Ride Video of S2E4, with the other two stations being Spring Lakeny Station and Allied Town Station.
  • According to the Railway Builder, the Chinese Name of this station refers to a friendly yet sarcastic way to greet a friend in Cantonese, and this name is used as this is how Samuel referred to the railway builder in that clip.[2]
  • The meaning of the Station name has often been misinterpreted as "You Jump off the Building" in order to fit the theme of Phoenix Line with the regards that Phoenixes are usually associated with being born again after dying.

History[]

  • September 3 2022: This station copmleted construction.[3]
  • September 4 2022: This station began services.

title: Lei Wah Depot
safeHtml:
Lei Wah Depot, originally named Shadow Shore Depot, is a depot constructed for Cometsilk Line of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and it is located at Los Sengas Cometsilk. However, it also provides services for StarTop Railway Cadence Line.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

  • Entrances: Two at the south, One at the north.
  • Hypothetical Capacity: 40 9-Carriage Trains
  • Facilities: Maintenance Pits, Platforms
  • This Depot is located to the west of Shadow Shore Station and Echo Cliffs Station.
  • This Depot can dispatch and retent vehicles from Azure Hook Station, Comet Channel Station, Waterbelt Garden Station, Shadow Shore Station and Echo Cliffs Station without disrupting services of other trains.
  • This Depot also provides vehicular servicing for Cadence Line trains, and is the first depot in Nazca Railway to share facilities with anothe railway company.

Fun Facts[]

  • The New Chinese name of this depot alludes to the naming of the Reiwa Era which occurred at the time of this depot's construction.
  • This depot completed construction and began services alongside Echo Cliffs Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station completed construction in less than 24 hours after the construction began.[2]
  • The Building Materials used in this station is identical to that of Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint.
  • This Station is built directly beneath a large roundabout. As a result, the concourse of this station is wider, and four exits of this station are located at each direction of the large roundabout.
  • This Station has the most exits among all Single-lined Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Stations at 16 Exits.[3]

History[]

  • June 6 2022: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • June 7 2022: This Station began services.
  • May 3 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Description []

Lima Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs from Old Brightland in TriPaw, proceeding through the Kaling Channel and Metropolis Sub-Districts in Downtown, before passing through Mayler Airport within Threeler, heading into central Sava, and reaching into of Odyssey.

This route is represented by Mona Lisa Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number L.

History[]

  • S4E1: Old Brightland - Sava Coast
  • S4E2: Old Brightland - Fishpond Vale
  • S4E4: Old Brightland - Keystone

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • West Ring Line: Metropolis to Sava Coast
    • East Ring Line: Metropolis to Kaling Channel
    • Pegasus Line: Metropolis to Old Brightland
    • Phoenix Line: Metropolis to Mayler Airport 1 (Through Maysang West Station and Skyward Line)
    • Odyssey Circular: Fishpond Vale to Keystone

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is the first line to be established in Season 4.

It was established alongside Omni Forest Station on November 14 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description []

Line CB4 is a line that runs along the centre of Belt Island in the south-north orientation. It is line Number 4 of CornBelt Light Transit and is represented by brown.

This line will extend to Frame Island.

Description []

Lingshan Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs from Valor to Snowty.

This route is represented by Shakespeare on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 41.

Districts Served[]

  • Valor
  • Intus Aquilo
  • Snowty

History[]

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Serve Passengers at East Intus Aquilo and West Snowty, running in parallel with Snowty Line and interchanging with Glacier Line in the process. Completed
(Chapter: S4E9)
Extend Eastwards from Lingshan North Station to interchange with Arcgo Line. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Starting from Lingshan North Station at the west, traverse east to interchange with Coopol Line (Twice), Arcgo Line, Asylum Line (Twice) and Ingress Line. TBC

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has not been explicitly mentioned in text for the Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition, the subsequent release of the Picture Version for Ingress Continent Development Plans have shown slight modifications with its Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline rendition. Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline suggests that this line with terminate at its interchange with Arcgo Line, whereas Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition sees it continue to the northeasterly area of Asylum. However, it should also be known that the route of this line within Intus Aquilo is not shown.[1]
  • This line will extend to Asylum and Coopol in the future.

Lingshan North Station is a station on Glacier Line and Lingshan Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Snowty. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2800 (Lingshan North NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that it is located at the north of Lingshan.
  • This English Name of this station is a Homophonic Translation of the Chinese Name of this station. However, the homophonic translation corresponds to both Cantonese and Putonghua.
  • Exit C of this Station has been relocated after the construction of the Lingshan Line Part.

History[]

  • November 1 2020: This station began services alongside Glacier Line.
  • March 19 2026: This station began expansion of the Lingshan Line Part.
  • March 21 2026: This station completed expansion of the Lingshan Line Part.
  • March 23 2026: Lingshan Line extends from Keene Hamlet Station to this station.

safeHtml:
The Home Ownership Scheme refers to a subsidised-sale public housing programme managed by the Housing Authority in Hong Kong that encourages better-off tenants of rental flats to vacate those flats for re-allocation to families in greater housing need, and to provide an opportunity for home ownership to families unable to afford to buy in the private sector.[1] Such housing also exists in Los Sengas, and this list denotes the Home Ownership Scheme Housing in Los Sengas.

Albums[]

As of July 2026, Nazca Railway has released a total of 352 soundtracks and 12 sets of albums, namely:

  • Soundtracks in relation to Station Updates:
    • "Gleams Between the Rails" (48);
    • "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy" (51);
    • "From Abyss to Aether" (47);
    • "Particles and Pinnacles" (52);
    • "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String" (54);
    • "Confluence of the Inner Lands" (51);
  • Soundtracks in relation to Main Development Episodes:
    • "Beneath Lanterns of Frozen Twilight" (6);
    • "Voices Under the Burden" (4);
    • "The Law in Half-Light." (4);
    • "Before the World Takes Sides." (6);
    • "Thawing Continuum." (7);
  • And Soundtracks in relation to Full Ride Videos
    • "Journey Along the Rails Vol. 1" (22)

Currently, Nazca Railway has Soundtracks for 147 Stations.

Planned Albums[]

In the Future, Nazca Railway will continue to release new Albums with regards to Updated Stations, Full Ride Videos and New Stations, including but not limited to:

  • Stations on or after the 100th Stations on the Update Order
  • Soundtracks Covering the NR Sprint Reports and Episode Review of S4E11: The Aestival Bay Nocturne
  • Soundtracks Covering Stations Built in S4E9 or Later
  • "Journey Along the Rails Vol. 2", which is likely to feature Soundtracks used in Various Full Ride Videos filmed in 2026.

Fun Facts[]

  • 3 of the Tracks in the Album "Journey Along the Rails Vol. 1", namely Rivers Under Stone, Noctilune Fields and Ascent into Winter were originally meant to be used for a Full Ride Video of Rover Line as of S4E7. However, due to technical issues, they are subsequently used in a newer Rover Line Full Ride Video in S4E10, after Corundum Fields Station is built.
